gt_provenance.details: Probe labels are LLM-judge (GPT-5.4) derived proxy annotations. Not model-self-derived GT, but not true external GT either. Kappa measures inter-run stability (0.77-1.00), not inter-annotator agreement.

score_normalization.details: ROC-AUC computed against 0/1 binary labels. First-PC alignment is raw cosine similarity. No metric normalized by model prediction statistics.

result_existence.details: AUC values (0.977, 0.840, 1.000, 0.892) and first-PC alignments (0.263, 0.364, 0.340, 0.447) consistent with runs/M1_locate/results.json structure. Direction files present.

dead_code.details: first_pc_alignment(), compute_sigma_proj(), train_probe_per_layer() all called and results stored in results.json.

scope.details: 200 chains, 4 behaviours, 32 layers. Report honest about predicate outcomes (AUC passes, first-PC fails). No overclaiming language.
